title: TabAgent: Distilling LLM Agent Components into Cheap Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2602.16429v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic systems, AI architectures that autonomously execute multi-step workflows to achieve complex goals, are often built using repeated large language model (LLM) calls for closed-set decision tasks such as routing, shortlisting, gating, and verification. While convenient, this design makes deployments slow and expensive due to cumulative latency and token usage. We propose TabAgent, a framework for replacing generative decision components in closed-set selection tasks with a compact textual-tabular classifier trained on execution traces. TabAgent (i) extracts structured schema, state, and dependency features from trajectories (TabSchema), (ii) augments coverage with schema-aligned synthetic supervision (TabSynth), and (iii) scores candidates with a lightweight classifier (TabHead). translated_title: TabAgent：将大语言模型智能体组件蒸馏为廉价分类器
translated_abstract: 智能体系统是能够自主执行多步骤工作流以实现复杂目标的人工智能架构，通常通过反复调用大语言模型（LLM）来完成路由、候选筛选、门控和验证等封闭集决策任务。这种设计虽然方便，但由于累积的延迟和token消耗，使得部署既缓慢又昂贵。我们提出TabAgent，这是一个用基于执行轨迹训练的紧凑文本-表格分类器来替换封闭集选择任务中生成式决策组件的框架。TabAgent（i）通过TabSchema从轨迹中提取结构化的模式、状态和依赖特征，（ii）通过TabSynth使用与模式对齐的合成监督来扩充数据覆盖范围，并（iii）通过TabHead使用轻量级分类器对候选项进行评分。在长时程AppWorld基准测试中，TabAgent在保持任务级成功率的同时消除了候选筛选阶段的LLM调用，将延迟降低约……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: TabAgent框架通过将智能体系统中反复调用的LLM生成式决策组件替换为基于执行轨迹训练的轻量级文本-表格分类器，在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低部署延迟和成本。
